load_LVISV05Dataset_data_list: load LVIS v0.5 dataset annotations from an annotation JSON file using the lvis API
load_LVISV1Dataset_data_list: load LVIS v1 dataset annotations by deriving file names from coco_url fields
register_LVISV05Dataset_module: register the LVIS v0.5 dataset class in the mmdet DATASETS registry for detection tasks
register_LVISV1Dataset_module: register the LVIS v1 dataset class in the mmdet DATASETS registry for detection tasks
review_LVISDataset_metainfo: review the LVIS dataset METAINFO classes tuple to inspect available object detection category labels
